notes.title: Mystical Mushrooms Update 0.1.53
notes.notes:
Change Log:

 fixed a few grammar issues
 fixed teleport issues
 fixed the save game issue


Tho I'm sorry to say that any previous save games are most likely going to be incompatible.
You will need to go into your ...\Steam\steamapps\common\Mystical Mushrooms\www\save and remove everything. This is bc after setting up the auto save plugin the old save games got slightly corrupted, also you will also most likely going to have to replay the game bc of the fast travel update. I'm sorry for the inconvenience.

For any bug reports, grammar reports or for smaller news to the game join the official discord: https://discord.com/invite/V96Zr4juTB

notes.title: Mystical Mushrooms Update 0.1.5
notes.notes:
It is here! Update 0.1.5 is here!

Change Log:

 Teleporting to the city is now fixed after the small area change.
 Sprite positions have been fixed.
 Added Cassie.
 Auto-saving has been added.
 The map has been reworked and is now more visible.
 BGM volume levels have been adjusted.
 Region names now appear when entering a named region.
 Logos at the start of the game are now skippable with a click.
 Fast travel has been reworked and improved.
 Traders now have icons indicating that they are traders.
 Bat has been redesigned.
 Goblin girls have been added.
 Added new achievements.
 New menu screen art (by @TheMintyCafe11)


I also added the option to go back to the last build in case anyone has issues with the current one.


Yes yes, i know it took me longer to make, but i kinda feel burned out atm, after I got the game on steam going I spent almost all my time on it. The plan for now is to work on the Game every 2 months. That way I can express myself and the story I want to tell way better. I thank you all for your patient.

For any bug reports or for smaller news to the game join the official discord: https://discord.com/invite/V96Zr4juTB

Safe travel my shrooms! <3

notes.title: Mystical Mushrooms Patch 0.1.42
notes.notes:
Change Log:


Enemy Changes
Weak Orc:

 HP increased to 80 HP
 Attack Damage reduced to 50 (with a variance of ±20%)
 Drops 10 EXP and 5 Noji


Medium Orc:

 HP increased to 130 HP
 Attack Damage increased to 100 (with a variance of ±20%)
 Drops 25 EXP and 10 Noji


Big Orc:

 HP increased to 250 HP
 Attack Damage increased to 150 (with a variance of ±20%)
 Drops 40 EXP and 25 Noji
 Orc Meat drop set to 3


Water Slime:

 HP increased to 80 HP
 Attack Damage decreased to 25 (with a variance of ±15%)
 Drops 20 EXP and 5 Noji


Cave Bat:

 HP increased to 60 HP
 Attack Damage increased to 70
 Drops 5 EXP and 2 Noji


Player Changes

 Spore damage increased
 Normal attack miss chance decreased
 Starting MP increased to 100
 Starting HP decreased to 300


Map Changes

 Smoke added to roofs
 Lights added to Cyne’s house (and some other houses)
 Cyne’s house now has a paper that displays the number of kills you've made
 Fire added to the tower's fireplace
 Fixed the crater starting the Monster Rising quest and temporarily removed the event until it’s properly implemented


Price Changes

 Mana Ring now costs 300
 Ring of Life now costs 350
 Elegant Mage Cloth now costs 600
 Fast Travel License now costs 250

(Since you now earn more money, these changes reflect that.)


New Achievements
For collecting the secret gold (If already completed, you’ll need to do it again—sorry!)


Orc Achievements:

 Kill 10 Orcs
 Kill 100 Orcs
 Kill 1.000 Orcs


Slime Achievements:

 Kill 10 Slimes
 Kill 100 Slimes
 Kill 1.000 Slimes


Bat Achievements:

 Kill 10 Bats
 Kill 100 Bats
 Kill 1.000 Bats



As for the achievement icons, I'm working on it!



More content aswell as more fixes are on the way!

Safe travel my shrooms! <3
